# Bundled Eruda DevTools

`eruda.min.js` is the standalone mobile in-browser console and DOM inspector by [Liri Liri](https://github.com/liriliri/eruda).

- **Version:** 3.4.1
- **License:** MIT
- **Provenance:** https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/eruda@3.4.1/eruda.min.js
- **SHA-256:** 6df3805da066f2dbaeaa547b4ca83fa5c7c10ca8b6ba4357b0897bf3cc3b9a1f

## Purpose

Bundled inside Bare as an offline, zero-network, CSP-bypassing in-browser developer tools console and element inspector.
